scope: Selected accelerator components, not whole chip; areas in library units.
hierarchy_caveat: ResNet4 ClockSinkDomain_4 uses frozen standalone AutoStage mappings. Its complete parent area is counted once; subtree areas are not added separately. This mapping can differ from original cross-boundary optimization.
simulation_caveat: Synthesis-only SRAM adaptations are not the unchanged simulator hardware; area and cycles do not constitute one validated implementation.

GemminiPatch.timing: Each nonzero-patch start preloads the full selected job into an active register cache using one synchronous SRAM read per cycle. Evaluation is held for patch_capacity + 1 cycles after start (9 for rows, 33 for wide), then resumes the original command-ready evaluator and parallel replay. Zero-patch starts bypass prefetch. Capture handshakes and module ports are unchanged. The original frozen simulation cycles do not describe this synthesis variant.
GemminiPatch.validation: Synthesis staging and static lint only; no dynamic equivalence or cycle validation.

validation.performance: Original simulator is unchanged; its cycles do not validate this SRAM variant.
